note: Dated events for this scenario, drawn only from mechanics the engine already has. Dates are the year and the week of that year. Magnitudes follow docs/rules/CONTENT-PACING.md. Titles and summaries are fictional framing with no real company or person names.

events.title: Reunification spending boom
events.summary: Billions flow east to rebuild roads, homes and factories. Western builders and suppliers are flooded with orders.

events.title: The central bank raises rates again
events.summary: Reunification spending is pushing prices up and the central bank answers with higher rates. Credit gets dearer.

events.title: State firms go up for sale
events.summary: A public agency starts selling off the eastern state firms. Buyers are lining up for the better ones, and the rest face closure.

events.title: The currency system comes under strain
events.summary: Speculators attack weaker currencies in the exchange rate system. Lenders turn cautious and export orders slow.

events.title: The steel industry slumps
events.summary: Cheap imports and weak demand push steel prices down. Mills cut shifts across the valley.

events.title: The economy shrinks
events.summary: The reunification boom is over and output falls for the first time in years. The central bank starts cutting.

events.title: Coal subsidies are cut
events.summary: The government trims the support that kept deep mines open. Coal prices fall and mining towns lose demand.

events.title: Growth returns
events.summary: Export orders recover and factories hire again.

events.title: Preparing for a shared currency
events.summary: Governments tighten budgets to meet the entry rules for a shared currency. Lenders raise their spreads for a while.
